# Daily Vibes For You

> A free iPhone app that delivers one hand-picked motivational quote each day, at a time you choose, in English or Hindi (हिंदी). No account, no ads, no tracking.

Daily Vibes For You is built by Ananya Banerjee and available on iPhone, iPad, Mac (Apple Silicon), and Apple Vision Pro. It is completely free with no in-app purchases, subscriptions, or ads. The app requires no account and collects no personal data of any kind. Daily reminders are scheduled on-device; the quote library refreshes over the internet.

## What it does

- Delivers one curated quote per day at a user-chosen time (any hour and minute).
- Library of 460+ quotes drawn from 50+ thinkers, authors, and philosophers, including Marcus Aurelius, Maya Angelou, Albert Einstein, Mahatma Gandhi, Eleanor Roosevelt, Confucius, and Abraham Lincoln.
- Available in English, Hindi (हिंदी), or both languages together; switchable at any time.
- Seven mood themes, each with its own artwork and colour palette: Warm Glow, Fierce Fire, Bold Energy, Dreamy Vibes, Deep Wisdom, Inner Peace, Stay Grounded.
- "Get New Vibes" returns a fresh quote in a new mood on demand.

## Facts

- Price: Free. No in-app purchases, no subscription, no ads.
- Platforms: iPhone and iPad (iOS/iPadOS 15.1+), Mac (macOS 12.0+, Apple Silicon), Apple Vision Pro (visionOS 1.0+). Not available on Android.
- Current version: 1.7.1. Download size approximately 40.7 MB.
- Account required: No. The app has no sign-up, login, or user profile.
- Data collected: None. No analytics SDKs, no ad networks, no third-party trackers. Language and reminder settings are stored on the device only.
- Offline behaviour: Daily reminders are scheduled on-device and fire without a connection. A built-in set of quotes is bundled with the app. The full 460+ library refreshes over the internet, so new quotes require a signal.
- Developer: Ananya Banerjee.

## Common questions

- Is Daily Vibes For You free? Yes, completely free with no in-app purchases, subscriptions, or ads.
- Does it work offline? Partly. Reminders are scheduled on-device and a built-in quote set works without a connection; the full library needs internet to refresh.
- Does it collect personal data? No. There is no account, no analytics, and no ad networks.
- Does it support Hindi? Yes. Quotes are available in English, Hindi (हिंदी), or both at once.
- How many quotes are there? More than 460, from over 50 thinkers.
- Can I choose when the quote arrives? Yes, you set the exact hour and minute for the daily reminder.
